sentences.text: This Court vide order dated 16.03.2018 has dismissed bunch of connected Miscellaneous Appeals of the Insurance Company including this appeal M.A.No.1292/2017.
In this appeal the respondent/claimant Parmanand filed cross objection which was not decided by the Court while deciding the appeals on the aforesaid date.
Hence, this cross objection is being decided today by this Court.
3. The date of accident, negligence and the issue of liability are not in dispute and the findings recorded by the Tribunal in this regard are also not in question.

As per the findings of the Tribunal,
for the claimant- Parmanand who suffered injuries, the Tribunal has awarded a total compensation of Rs.10,000/- along with interest.

4. Learned counsel for the claimant submits that the Tribunal has committed an error in not awarding just and proper amount of compensation in the case as the amount awarded by the Tribunal is on the lower side.
The Tribunal has assessed the income of the respondent on lower side.

The Tribunal has also committed error in not considering the medical expenses and not awarding any amount for special diet, future medical treatment, pain and suffering and loss of expectancy of life.
Hence, prays for enhancement of the compensation.

5. Learned counsel for the Insurance Company argued in support of the impugned award and contended that the Claims Tribunal has rightly awarded the compensation amount in the case which does not call for any interference by this Court and prays for rejection of the cross objection.

6. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
7.
After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record, I find substance in the arguments advanced by the counsel for the respondent/claimant.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the arguments advanced by the counsel for the parties and the evidence that came on record, in the considered opinion of this court, it would be just and proper to award a further lump sum amount of Rs.20,000/- over and above the amount which has already been awarded by the Tribunal.
8. Accordingly, the respondent-claimant is entitled to an additional sum o f Rs.20,000/- over and above the amount which has been awarded by the Tribunal.
9 . In the result, the cross objection is partly allowed.
The enhanced amount shall bear interest at the same rate as awarded by the Tribunal.
The other findings recorded by the Tribunal shall remain intact.

(HIRDESH) JUDGE RJ United India Insurance Co.Ltd. vs Paramnand on 9 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/141963107/
